name: DCS Cloud
description: Bootstrap the dcs CLI (download + auto-update + PAT login), then operate DCS Cloud by running the CLI directly.
description_zh: 引导 dcs CLI（下载、自动更新、PAT 登录），之后直接执行 CLI 操作 DCS Cloud：项目、任务、工作流、计费、数据文件。用户需在云平台个人中心创建个人访问令牌(PAT)并粘贴到连接器。
description_en: Bootstrap the dcs CLI (download, auto-update, PAT login), then run the CLI directly to operate DCS Cloud: projects, tasks, workflows, billing, and data files. Create a Personal Access Token (PAT) in the cloud platform profile page and paste it into the connector.

examples_en: Show current project and task list
